### Power Point - Aug. 2, 2006
Author: PowerPoint Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-aug-2-2006-1411699.html
Passage: Proverbs 1:10
Points:
- Modern media and technology constantly risk inviting worldly impurity into Christian homes.
- Parents serve as the most crucial defense system for safeguarding their children's spiritual purity.
- Establishing clear, reasonable boundaries regarding entertainment, internet access, and friendships is vital.
- Protecting young hearts requires vigilance against spiritual enemies, even when setting rules causes friction.
